summary: Tested the Magazzino module (stock module) end to end. Backend: 18/18 pytest passed (new file test_iteration30_magazzino.py). It covers the article magazzino fields, every validation on POST /movimenti, the weighted average (200@0.10 + 100@0.40 -> 0.20, scarico at avg, valore=giacenza*avg), backdated scarico that would go negative -> 400 'Giacenza insufficiente', signed rettifica, giacenza_dopo, the dal/al/tipo filters, sottoscorta/riepilogo/da_ordinare=max(lotto, min-giacenza), the esaurito state, DELETE recompute and its negative-stock refusal, operatore 403 on DELETE, article delete blocked when movements exist, fatturazione-off -> 403, and 400/401 when the company header or auth is missing. Frontend (desktop 1920 + mobile 390): Articles dialog switch/fields persist, giacenza column + badge, sottoscorta-section quantities, error toast on article delete, Archivi > Magazzino nav, KPIs, all 3 tabs, carico/scarico/rettifica via row buttons, header buttons and sottoscorta 'Carico' preset, scarico hides costo, insufficient-stock toast keeps the dialog open, movimenti filter, delete toast/refusal, dashboard magazzino-panel, operatore can register but sees no delete buttons. Mobile has no horizontal page overflow. No blocking bugs found.

minor.issue: Changing codice/descrizione/unita_misura does not update the copies stored on stock_moves (codice, descrizione, unita_misura), so the Movimenti list shows the old code.

gestione_magazzino can be switched off on an article that still has stock and movements. It then disappears silently from the valuation and from /magazzino/articoli. Consider blocking this or warning the user.

issues: Row carico/scarico buttons are icon-only (PackagePlus vs PackageMinus look almost the same at 14px) and have no title/aria-label
On mobile 390px the action buttons are only reachable by scrolling the table sideways
There is no loading state: the empty message 'Nessun articolo gestito...' and 0 KPIs show briefly before the data arrives
The API returns giacenza_dopo when filtered by article, but the table does not show a 'Giacenza dopo' column
Default date uses new Date().toISOString() (UTC), so between 00:00 and 01:00/02:00 Italian time it defaults to the previous day
For a negative rettifica the costo input is still shown (and prefilled), but it is ignored

action_items: Optional: update codice/descrizione/unita_misura on stock_moves when an article is edited, or join them at read time
Optional: block or warn when gestione_magazzino is turned off on an article with stock

Optional: add title/aria-label to the giacenza-carico/scarico icon buttons; show a giacenza_dopo column when the movimenti filter is set; add a loading state; use the local date as the default in MovimentoDialog
critical_code_review_comments: magazzino.py: DELETE uses delete_one({id}) without company_id. This is safe because the record was just looked up with company_id, but it is inconsistent with the rest of the code.
Movimenti list is capped at 2000 rows with no pagination; recompute loads up to 100k movements per call (fine for an MVP).
Magazzino.jsx load() swallows movimenti errors silently (catch(() => {})).
